title: EndpointMaterialization
description: Materialization status for an endpoint version.

can_materialize.description: Whether this endpoint query can be materialized.

reason.description: Reason why materialization is not possible (only when can_materialize is false).

last_materialized_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful materialization.

error.description: Last materialization error message, if any.

saved_query_id.description: UUID of the underlying saved query backing this materialization. Only populated when the version is materialized.
